title: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) — Classical Ayurvedic Monograph
source: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) & Ministry of AYUSH
content:
Herb / Medicine: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera / Indian Ginseng).
Classical Ayurvedic Properties: Rasa: Tikta, Kashaya, Madhura. Veerya: Ushna (Hot). Vipaka: Madhura. Balances Vata and Kapha doshas. Classified as Balya (strength promoter), Rasayana (rejuvenator), and Medhya (nootropic).
Pharmacology & Clinical Evidence: Withanolides modulate the HPA axis, reducing serum cortisol levels by up to 28-30% in clinical trials. Enhances GABA-ergic neurotransmission to reduce anxiety and improve sleep architecture.
Dosage & Administration: Root extract powder: 3-6 grams daily with warm milk and ghee. Standardized root extract (KSM-66 / Sensoril): 300-600mg daily.
Contraindications & Precautions: Avoid during pregnancy (uterine stimulant properties). Caution in hyperthyroidism and autoimmune conditions.
